essence: The ritual object is specified as having a hole appropriately sized for the ring finger.
The object, presided over by Īśvara, should be placed as before in the south and in both locations.
The desired ring for that purpose should be made of gold.
The object’s length should range from twelve measures up to thirty-six finger-breadths.
A darbha grass garland should be made with a circumference equal to that of the little finger.
